route_title: Defect-cavity narrowband transmission filter at 1550 nm using Ta2O5/SiO2 quarter-wave stacks
compilation_rationale: Drafted 29-layer distributed Bragg reflector with a central SiO2 defect cavity, initializing mirror layers at quarter-wave and cavity at half-wave optical thickness near 1550 nm. Bounds constrained to 50–400 nm. Optimization maximizes transmission at resonance while minimizing leakage across adjacent stopbands using mean transmittance objectives.
